description: List every category in the Agentropolis index with its listing count, largest first (about 18 snake_case ids such as web_search, crypto_onchain_data, llm_inference). Use it to pick a valid value for search_kits' category filter or to see what the index covers; for paid-usage numbers per category use get_market_snapshot. Read-only, no parameters. Category pages with prices and verified buyers: /categories.
name: list_categories
title: List index categories with listing counts
